dct_description_sm:
A Recreation Point is a point feature that identifies a site designated for recreational activities.

Different Recreation Access Point types collected by the Natural Resources Values Information System (NRVIS) include
  • Access Point
  • Boat Cache, Commercial
  • Boat Cache, Private
  • Boat Cache, Resource Harvest
  • Boathouse
  • Clubhouse
  • Designated Camping Site
  • Picnic Site
We are no longer updating this data. It is best suited for historical research and analysis.
